blocks.text: Yeh amino acids ki chains (zanjeeron) se bane hote hain. Yeh water-soluble (pani mein hal hone wale) hain, yani khoon mein asaani se ghul jate hain. Lekin yeh cell membrane ke paar nahin ja sakte. Is liye yeh cell ki sateh (surface) par maujood receptors se jurte hain. Misalein:

blocks.caption: Peptide aur protein hormones
rows: Khoon mein glucose ki miqdar kam karta hai.
Khoon mein glucose ki miqdar barhata hai.
Growth aur cells ki taqseem (cell reproduction) barhata hai.
Bachche ki paidaish ke waqt muscles ko sukerta (contract karwata) hai.
